name: com.devgame.editor-presence
description: Streams the current Unity Editor selection and play/pause state to a DevGame chat composer over the Editor Presence Protocol (EPP). Reporting-only: it publishes what's happening in your Editor, but issuing play/stop/pause commands, status polling, console, tests, and screenshots all go through Unity's own official com.unity.pipeline package, not this one. See docs/workbench/spec-editor-presence.md and unity/README.md in the DevGame repo. Editor-only; nothing in this package ships in a player build.
